data.name: Pass for Human
data.description: When trying to conceal her half-orc heritage, a skulking slayer gains a bonus on Disguise checks equal to half her level. When using disguise to appear as a specific individual, skulking stalkers ignore the normal -2 penalty to appear as another race.
